mapping_flags.label: OPENINGS NOT TIED TO WALLS: 35 openings are not assigned to a wall in this report. Window and door trim is figured against ALL openings until you say which sit on the siding — close this with the in-scope counts.
mapping_flags.verify: Walk the openings — count which sit in the sided walls vs the excluded area

mapping_flags.label: Corner sticks are figured from total corner length — the report gives counts and total feet, not each corner's own height, so the per-corner figure is an average. An average hides any corner taller than one 16' stick (an 18'5" corner takes 2). Tape tall corners on the walk — close with the taped heights.
mapping_flags.verify: Walk the corners — confirm counts AND tape any corner taller than 16'

mapping_flags.label: PORCH CEILINGS LIKELY: measured soffit 2620 ft² over 627.67 LF of eaves+rakes works out to a 4.2' average overhang vs the stated 1' — porch ceilings are probably inside that soffit number. Measure them and enter porch entries in Job Info.
mapping_flags.verify: Measure porch ceilings on site and enter them in Job Info

mapping_flags.label: Batten height figured from the report: stacked wall height 15.8 ft = sided 4239 ft² ÷ footprint perimeter 268.67 ft — good enough to sell; tape the wall heights at the house before material orders (taped replaces figured, reversible)
mapping_flags.verify: On any board-and-batten job: tape the wall heights at the house before ordering — taped replaces figured, battens re-figure live

mapping_flags.label: Opening schedule not itemized (report gives counts only) — starter deduction and window/door wrap run on per-count standards, not each opening's own size.
